events.title: DYNA Robotics Fireside w/ SPC's Embodied AI Forum
events.description:
South Park Commons' Embodied AI Forum is delighted to host the founders of DYNA Robotics.
Event Details
2:30pm: Doors Open
3:00 - 4:00pm: Fireside Chat

Bio: Jason Ma is the co-founder of Dyna, which he started with Lindon Gao and York Yang in 2024. Dyna's pushing the boundaries of robot foundation models and deploying them in the field, now running in laundromats and Din Tai Fung, folding 1590 table napkins a day. Jason leads the research, from DYNA-1 to DYNA-2 world-action model, the first to show scaling laws for human-video-to-robot transfer. Before Dyna, he did his PhD at UPenn's GRASP Lab and researched at DeepMind, NVIDIA and Meta AI, where his work included Eureka (LLM-driven reward design), VIP (visual rewards learned from video), Open X-Embodiment and DROID robot datasets.

events.title: Fireside Chat with Tony Zhao, Sunday Robotics
events.description:
South Park Commons is delighted to host Tony Zhao, co-founder and CEO at Sunday Robotics, for a fireside chat.
Event Details
5:30pm: Doors Open
6:00-7:00pm: Fireside Chat

Tony Zhao is the co-founder and CEO of Sunday Robotics. He is building general-purpose home robots that give people time back for what matters most. He earned his B.S. in EECS from UC Berkeley in 2021 and later pursued a PhD in Computer Science at Stanford. His research in robotic fine manipulation contributed to ALOHA and ACT, influential projects and methods that helped advance imitation learning in robotics. Before founding Sunday Robotics, Tony worked at Google DeepMind and Tesla Autopilot.
